text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still gasping for breath after a song, Smart Falcon calls out to the crowd. The response is lukewarm.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Not one to be discouraged, she encourages the crowd to sing with her and begins another number.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Eventually, a few students start to hum along. The sheer passion emanating from the stage draws eyes. Slowly but surely, I feel something changing in the air.
